# DR(eye)VE

Real driving recordings with gaze fixations, task-dependent saliency and telemetry.

## Example input and output

This is a source-grounded illustration of the task shape, not a copied or verified dataset row.

**Input:** A road video with aligned gaze, GPS, speed and course observations.

**Output / label:** Attention/fixation cues; no original intention class is asserted.

[Open the author-provided sample or demo](https://aimagelab-legacy.ing.unimore.it/imagelab/researchActivity.asp?idActivity=033)

**Example evidence:** [official](https://aimagelab-legacy.ing.unimore.it/imagelab/researchActivity.asp?idActivity=033)

## Intention in this dataset

Gaze provides task-dependent attention cues relevant to driver intention modelling; fixation and saliency maps themselves are not intention or maneuver labels.

**Relevance:** `related` · **Origin:** `real` · **Year:** 2016

**Domains:** driver_behavior, autonomous_driving  
**Intention types:** driving_maneuver  
**Tasks:**   
**Modalities:** rgb, gaze, trajectory, vehicle_telemetry  
**Formats:** video, time_series, structured_annotation
